skill.summary: content creators and marketers edit raw video footage into AI-edited videos using this skill. Accepts MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB, renders on cloud GPUs...

latestVersion.changelog:
Video AI — Initial Release

- Launches cloud-based AI video editing for creators and marketers.
- Accepts raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) with editing requests, delivering enhanced 1080p MP4s in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles file uploads, auto-edits (e.g., silence removal, captions), and exports results server-side.
- Easy session setup with free starter credits; supports API-based workflows for upload, edit, export, and status tracking.
- Detailed error handling and guidance for common workflows and supported formats.
